words.defn_en: to give off:

sentences.en: The old furnace began to ______ a strange odor after years of use.
sentences.zh: 這個舊暖爐使用多年後,開始散發出一股怪味。

sentences.en: Certain stars ______ light that can be detected from millions of miles away.
sentences.zh: 某些恆星發出的光線能在數百萬英里外被偵測到。

words.defn_en: proposition for argument:

sentences.en: The whole argument rests on the ______ that everyone acts in their own self-interest.
sentences.zh: 整個論點都建立在人人都出於自身利益行事這個前提上。

sentences.en: If the initial ______ is false, the entire conclusion falls apart.
sentences.zh: 如果最初的假設是錯誤的,整個結論就會站不住腳。

words.defn_en: to guess:

sentences.en: From the muddy footprints, the detective could ______ that the thief had escaped through the garden.
sentences.zh: 從泥濘的腳印,偵探可以猜測小偷是從花園逃跑的。

sentences.en: We can only ______ what really happened, since no witnesses came forward.
sentences.zh: 由於沒有目擊者出面,我們只能猜測到底發生了什麼事。

words.defn_en: careless, negligent:

sentences.en: It would be ______ of me not to mention the risks involved.
sentences.zh: 如果我不提及其中涉及的風險,那將是我的怠忽職守。

sentences.en: He was ______ in checking the safety equipment before the climb.
sentences.zh: 他在攀登前未能盡責檢查安全裝備。

words.defn_en: unrelieved, as bad as can be:

sentences.en: The concert was an ______ disaster from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 這場演唱會從頭到尾都是一場徹頭徹尾的災難。

sentences.en: His plan turned out to be an ______ failure.
sentences.zh: 他的計畫結果證明是一場徹底的失敗。

words.defn_en: representative, envoy:

sentences.en: The king sent an ______ to negotiate peace with the neighboring nation.
sentences.zh: 國王派遣了一位使者前去與鄰國協商和平。

sentences.en: A special ______ was dispatched to deliver the confidential message.
sentences.zh: 一位特派密使被派去傳遞這份機密訊息。

words.defn_en: to make or become less severe; to lessen pain or damage

sentences.en: The company took steps to ______ the environmental damage caused by the spill.
sentences.zh: 這家公司採取措施,以減輕這次外洩事故所造成的環境損害。

sentences.en: Wearing a helmet can ______ the severity of a head injury.
sentences.zh: 戴安全帽可以減輕頭部受傷的嚴重程度。

words.defn_en: voluntarily obeying another; humble

sentences.en: The trainer taught the dog to be calm and ______.
sentences.zh: 訓練師教導這隻狗要保持冷靜順從。

sentences.en: She refused to remain ______ in a relationship that disrespected her.
sentences.zh: 她拒絕在一段不尊重她的感情中繼續保持順從。

words.defn_en: dedicated to a cause or task:

sentences.en: Ava is ______ to her studies and always wants top grades.
sentences.zh: 艾娃全心投入於學業,總是希望拿到最高的成績。

sentences.en: He remains fully ______ to finishing the marathon despite his injury.
sentences.zh: 儘管受了傷,他仍然全心堅持要完成這場馬拉松。

words.defn_en: to reject or send away:

sentences.en: The teacher ______ the idea to end class early.
sentences.zh: 老師駁回了提早下課的提議。

sentences.en: The judge decided to ______ the case due to lack of evidence.
sentences.zh: 法官因證據不足而決定駁回此案。

words.defn_en: showing disregard or lack of interest; treating something as unworthy of attention:

sentences.en: Her ______ attitude towards the suggestions irritated the group.
sentences.zh: 她對這些建議不屑一顧的態度激怒了大家。

sentences.en: He gave a ______ wave of his hand and walked away.
sentences.zh: 他不耐煩地揮了揮手,然後就走開了。

words.defn_en: the production and discharge of something, especially gas:

sentences.en: The new law limits carbon ______ s from factories.
sentences.zh: 這項新法限制了工廠的碳排放。

sentences.en: Scientists measured the ______ of heat from the volcano.
sentences.zh: 科學家測量了這座火山釋放的熱量。

words.defn_en: not able to be lessened or eased:
words.defn_zh: 無法減輕的;無法緩解的

sentences.en: The disease caused ______ pain in its final stages.
sentences.zh: 這種疾病在末期造成了無法減輕的疼痛。

sentences.en: His guilt seemed ______ despite years of therapy.
sentences.zh: 儘管多年的治療,他的罪惡感似乎仍無法緩解。

words.defn_en: occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous:

sentences.en: The area experienced ______ rain throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 這個地區整天都下著間歇性的雨。

sentences.en: His ______ cough worried the doctor.
sentences.zh: 他斷斷續續的咳嗽讓醫生感到擔心。

words.defn_en: to release from slavery:

sentences.en: The plantation owner chose to ______ several enslaved workers before his death.
sentences.zh: 這位莊園主在去世前選擇解放了幾名被奴役的工人。

sentences.en: Historical records show when the state began to ______ its enslaved population.
sentences.zh: 歷史紀錄顯示這個州何時開始解放境內被奴役的人口。

words.defn_en: a letter, especially a formal or lengthy one:

sentences.en: He received a lengthy ______ from his estranged brother.
sentences.zh: 他收到了一封來自疏遠已久的兄弟的長篇書信。

sentences.en: The ambassador sent an urgent ______ to the capital.
sentences.zh: 這位大使發出了一封緊急公函給首都。

words.defn_en: a common misspelling of missile, a weapon or object propelled toward a target:
words.root_note: mittere (to send), from Latin, variant spelling

sentences.en: The military tested a new long-range ______ in the desert.
sentences.zh: 軍方在這片沙漠中測試了一款新型的遠程飛彈。

sentences.en: Protesters hurled a ______ toward the police barricade.
sentences.zh: 抗議者朝警方的路障投擲了一枚拋擲物。

words.defn_en: a tiny arachnid; a small amount or contribution:

sentences.en: Dust ______ s can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.
sentences.zh: 塵蟎可能會引發敏感體質者的過敏反應。

sentences.en: She donated a small ______ to the relief fund each month.
sentences.zh: 她每個月都會捐出一筆微薄的款項給這個救濟基金。

words.defn_en: capable of being lessened or made less severe:

sentences.en: Engineers determined the flood risk was ______ with proper drainage.
sentences.zh: 工程師確認只要有適當的排水系統,這項洪水風險是可以減輕的。

sentences.en: The judge considered whether the sentence was ______ due to his age.
sentences.zh: 這位法官考慮是否因他的年齡而減輕這項判決。

words.defn_en: to allow something; an official document granting authorization:
words.root_note: permittere (to let pass through), from Latin per- (through) + mittere (to send)

sentences.en: The landlord would not ______ pets in the apartment.
sentences.zh: 房東不允許在這間公寓裡飼養寵物。

sentences.en: She applied for a building ______ before starting the renovation.
sentences.zh: 她在開始整修之前申請了建築許可證。

words.defn_en: the act of yielding to authority; something submitted for consideration:
words.root_note: submittere, from Latin sub- (under) + mittere (to send)

sentences.en: The rebels eventually forced the garrison into ______ .
sentences.zh: 叛軍最終迫使這座駐軍要塞屈服投降。

sentences.en: The magazine received hundreds of ______ s for the writing contest.
sentences.zh: 這本雜誌為這場寫作比賽收到了數百件投稿。

words.defn_en: to accept or yield to authority; to present for consideration:
words.root_note: submittere, from Latin sub- (under) + mittere (to send)

sentences.en: He refused to ______ to the demands of the hijackers.
sentences.zh: 他拒絕屈服於這些劫機者的要求。

sentences.en: Applicants must ______ their forms before the deadline.
sentences.zh: 申請人必須在截止日期前提交他們的表格。
